mechanism: Indomethacin may increase fluphenazine levels through CYP450 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while NSAIDs increase risk of extrapyramidal side effects and neuroleptic malignant syndrome when combined with antipsychotics.
action: Monitor for extrapyramidal symptoms, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, and fluphenazine toxicity; consider alternative NSAID or non-NSAID analgesic; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
